name: @zgeoff/skill-gate
description: A Claude Code hook that denies an edit or a gated tool call until the session loads the skills and reads the reference files it needs, and blocks after a Bash command that changed a gated file without them

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:outdir dist
scripts.build:outdir: sh -c 'bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir "$0" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir "$0"'
